thesis: Hold the existing event-driven weights instead of chasing the screen's largest recent winners. On the latest settled session, VRTX gained 2.06% and NEM gained 3.79%, lifting the marked book 0.85% while SPY gained 0.28%, about 0.57 points of daily alpha. The longer record remains poor: marked equity is $84.00, all-time alpha is about -19.3 points, and the 44-session annualized Sharpe is -3.50. Newmont reports Q3 after the October 22 close, Vertex reports Q3 after the November 2 close, and FDA assigned November 30 as the povetacicept PDUFA target date. Robinhood data shows VRTX at 29.001949x trailing earnings and NEM at 14.087104x; the earnings calendar carries EPS estimates of $0.88 for VRTX and $1.94 for NEM. The screen leaders MRNA, SHOP, and PLTR have large recent gains and either loss-making or high-multiple fundamentals, so they do not improve the analyst's anticipatory edge. Keep VRTX at 16%, NEM at 14%, and 70% cash. This is the project's paper-portfolio bridge, not an official plugin investment recommendation.

Vertex says FDA assigned a November 30, 2026 PDUFA target date for povetacicept in IgAN; the supporting Phase 3 interim analysis showed a 49.8% UPCR reduction versus placebo with P<0.0001.
Vertex says it will report Q3 2026 results on November 2 after market close and host its call at 4:30 p.m. ET.
Newmont says it will release Q3 2026 results after market close on October 22 and hold its call at 5:30 p.m. EDT.
Robinhood's October 16 data shows VRTX at 29.001949x P/E, $127.7013 billion market cap, Q2 revenue $3.3339 billion, Q2 net income $1.0998 billion, and a $575.9630 mean analyst target.
Robinhood's October 16 data shows NEM at 14.087104x P/E, $123.6402 billion market cap, Q2 revenue $6.118 billion, Q2 net income $2.202 billion, and a $139.4712 mean analyst target.
At the October 15 settled close, VRTX was $508.75, NEM was $115.79, and SPY was $771.79; VRTX rose 2.06%, NEM rose 3.79%, and SPY rose 0.28% from October 14.

risks: VRTX faces a binary November 30 FDA decision; a delay, rejection, restrictive label, or adverse safety interpretation breaks the thesis.
NEM remains below the paper entry despite a 3.79% latest-session gain; weak October 22 production or cost results can invalidate the valuation case.
The Robinhood analyst consensus is not an independent edge; both stocks can fall even if results meet consensus.
A 70% cash balance creates material opportunity cost if risk assets rally.
The persisted portfolio has about -19.3 points of all-time alpha and a -3.50 Sharpe; confidence stays low until realized results improve.

rationale.VRTX: [DATA] FDA assigned a November 30, 2026 PDUFA target date for povetacicept, and Vertex confirmed Q3 results for November 2. The October 15 close was $508.75, up 2.06%; Robinhood reported P/E/PB of 29.001949/6.237380, Q2 revenue of $3.3339 billion, Q2 net income of $1.0998 billion, a $575.9630 mean analyst target, and a Q3 EPS estimate of $0.88. [ASSUMED] Approval can establish a nephrology franchise faster than the market credits, but the binary outcome and negative long-run portfolio alpha cap the anchor at 16%.
rationale.NEM: [DATA] Newmont confirmed Q3 results after the October 22 close; Robinhood's earnings calendar shows a $1.94 EPS estimate. The October 15 close was $115.79, up 3.79%; Robinhood reported P/E/PB of 14.087104/3.352210, Q2 revenue of $6.118 billion, Q2 net income of $2.202 billion, and a $139.4712 mean analyst target. [ASSUMED] Stable production and costs could beat the $1.94 consensus, but the below-entry position and commodity risk cap the weight at 14%.

reflection.looking_back: The carried book entered October 15 with VRTX and NEM at 16% and 14% targets and 70% cash. Marked to October 15, the book gained 0.85% while SPY gained 0.28%, producing about 0.57 points of daily alpha; VRTX rose 2.06% and NEM rose 3.79%.
worked: VRTX and NEM both advanced, lifting the marked book 0.85% and beating SPY by about 0.57 points for the session.
Both positions retain company-confirmed, dated catalysts, so the theses remain falsifiable rather than momentum extrapolations.
missed: NEM remains 9.2% below its paper entry despite the rebound, so the October 22 result still carries material downside risk.
Another positive-alpha session does not repair about -19.3 points of all-time alpha or the -3.50 Sharpe.
reflection.adjustment: Hold VRTX at 16%, NEM at 14%, and cash at 70%; reject high-multiple momentum leaders without a differentiated pre-event thesis.
